name: 8001-batchdecode-dsv2lite-dp8
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 of one node, NV18 all-to-all NVLink.
parallelism: TP=8 with data-parallel attention at DP=8 on eight GPUs of one node: attention weights and KV replicated per rank, the 64 routed experts sharded 8 per rank. No expert or pipeline parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 1024 prompt tokens in and 512 tokens out both fixed, temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, no shared prefix and the prefix cache off.
purpose: A chat assistant generating long replies from page-length prompts for 16 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang 0.4.9.post2-era ServerArgs: every key here becomes a launch flag, and a key that is
# not a ServerArgs field at this version fails at launch. Do not add keys from a later sglang.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true

disable-overlap-schedule: true
disable-radix-cache: true

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
context-length: 4096
